speech.heard: The USA puts 21.3% of its economy into fixed assets, but one giant breaks this pattern. Between the UK, the USA, and China, one reinvests a far larger share into fixed capital. The UK puts 18.9% of its economy into fixed assets. The USA puts 21.3%, putting income into infrastructure and equipment. China charges ahead, putting 39.7% of its economy into fixed capital. Yet Tanzania tops the world, putting 42.2% of its economy into fixed assets. Bhutan follows right behind, putting 42.1% into fixed assets. How much of its economy does your country put into fixed assets?
